title: Smelt It Down
subtitle: A count, so the progress bar appears
description: The bar's fill is the available green and its track is a dark brown. Green on brown is
a combination that appears nowhere else in the gallery, and it is either the reason to
use this theme or the reason not to.
Bars are useful in a gallery for exactly this: six pixels of a saturated colour on a
desaturated surface is a pairing that no amount of description gets across.
